faq.a: Marat is associated with the Arabic form مُرَاد, whose core sense is marat; wish, desire (central asian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Marat?
faq.a: Marat is associated with Arabic. Marat is the Central Asian form of Arabic مُرَاد (Murād), meaning 'wish, desire'.
Yes — the underlying form مُرَاد is Arabic.
